messages:
Sheila: Quick sync — running the weekly access mosaic. Need to reconcile a few things before Tue's prune: 1) KMS key owners mismatch in project-analytics, 2) stale admin sessions >30d, 3) missing audit hooks for a subset of Dedicated nodes. Who can take which?
Praveen: I can take KMS owners. Found two keys with no owner tag, will ping the services team. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Alex: I can do the stale admin sessions sweep. Planning to run the query and generate a CSV for owners to ack.
Jordan: I’ll investigate the audit hook gaps — saw 5 nodes in eu-west where loghook wasn't deployed after last infra roll. Probable config drift.
Sheila: Awesome. For KMS owners, add an "owner_email" tag and update the central keymap. If you hit cross-project grants, blink me.
Praveen: noted. quick command I'll run: `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --project=project-analytics --format="table(name,labels.owner)"` and then `jq` the output into our keymap.
Alex: Stale admin sessions query I plan to run: `SELECT principal, last_active FROM admin_sessions WHERE last_active < now() - interval '30 days'` will dump to s3://redwood-ops/access-audit/admin-stale-$(date +%F).csv
Jordan: For loghook, I'll check the daemonset rollout: `kubectl -n infra get daemonset loghook -o wide` and compare nodeSelector / tolerations. If it's missing, I'll reapply the rollout patch and annotate the nodes we touched.
sec-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-041 - Access Mosaic: missing loghook on eu-west nodes (assigned: Jordan).
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tomorrow at 09:00 PT — Jordan will be primary.
Sheila: For risk triage: low-risk stale sessions (no active keys) — automate a 7-day temp-disable notify cycle. For any KMS key with cross-project grants, mark as medium and require a manual owner confirmation.
Praveen: If I find ownerless keys, I'll create a PR against infra/keymap with a `--proposed-owner` tag and request review from the service lead.
Alex: After CSV generation I’ll kick an email to owners with a one-click revoke link that triggers a workflow. I'll drop the link here when done.
Sheila: Perfect. Action items: Praveen (KMS owner tags), Alex (stale session CSV + revoke workflow), Jordan (deploy loghook and annotate nodes). We'll regroup tomorrow 10:30 PT for verification.
Jordan: FYI I'm seeing a related vuln alert in Snyk for the loghook sidecar image (CVE-2025-1234). I'll add it to vuln triage — probably a patchable downgrade.
Sheila: Add to triage board and mark as "blocker for deployment" until fixed or mitigated. If patch not immediate, apply network egress rule to restrict image pulling or use a vetted mirror.
Praveen: Heads-up — keymap PR will include KMS key fingerprint and last-rotation timestamp for owners to confirm.
Alex: CSV job scheduled now. Will post link when upload completes.
sec-bot: Audit log export started for project-analytics -> gs://redwood-audit-exports/project-analytics/3325000000/ (export id: exp-3325).
Sheila: Thanks everyone. If anything urgent pops, ping me @here. I'll post the verification checklist after Jordan confirms node annotations.
Alex: Uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/access-audit/admin-stale-3325000000.csv — sending owner emails now.
Jordan: loghook redeployed and nodes annotated: nodes annotated: node-eu-01,node-eu-02,node-eu-05. Will monitor rolling logs for 30m.
Sheila: Closing loop — can each of you add a one-line comment in this thread when your item is complete? Helps for the audit record.
Praveen: KMS owner tags added and PR opened: infra/keymap#457 — requesting review from @service-leads.
Alex: Revoke workflow sent, owners started acknowledging. CSV and audit trail attached to the PR.
Jordan: loghook redeploy stable after 25m. CVE noted in triage, remediations planned.
Sheila: Great — marking thread as covered for this sweep. Will include these notes in the weekly compliance digest. :white_check_mark:
